title: com.list arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

thread.description: Only this thread's messages; absent: every thread the caller's Project takes part in.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page, bound to this reader, its grant revision, this filter and the restore epoch; a changed filter is cursor_reset_required.

limit.description: At most this many messages on the page; the board may return fewer.

unread.description: true: only messages delivered to this reader's Project (DEC-0135 DR-1 to DR-5) that it has not marked read (DEC-0098). Either filter makes every message of the page carry read; a cursor is bound to the filter.

since.description: Only messages stored at or after this time (DEC-0098).
